hypothesis.statement: The sector-relative 15-minute return prior to 13:00 ET predicts the next 60-minute sector-relative return with a negative cross-sectional rank IC (mean-reversion). Signal is used long-only: buy the bottom cross-sectional decile (biggest recent sector-relative losers) at 13:00 ET, hold for 60 minutes, close by 14:00 ET, on liquid U.S. equities.
hypothesis.signal_definition: ret_15m_sec_rel = close_t / close_{t-3 bars} - 1 minus close_{sector_ETF(i), t} / close_{sector_ETF(i), t-3 bars} + 1, where sector_ETF(i) is the SPDR sector ETF for ticker i's GICS sector (mapping in phase0/sector_map.py). Both stock and ETF close prices are on the reindexed 78-bar 09:30-15:55 ET grid, and the L-bar shift is partitioned by (ticker, session_date_et) so no term crosses overnight.
hypothesis.target_definition: fwd_ret_60m_sec_rel = close_{i, t+12 bars} / close_{i, t} - 1 minus close_{sector_ETF(i), t+12 bars} / close_{sector_ETF(i), t} + 1, again partitioned by (ticker, session_date_et).
hypothesis.primary_metric: Spearman cross-sectional Rank IC of ret_15m_sec_rel vs fwd_ret_60m_sec_rel at 13:00 ET, mean across sessions, block bootstrap CI.
supporting_metrics: Decile monotonicity (Spearman of decile vs mean forward return)

phase0_notes: Reversal cluster (L=15m near 13:00 ET) chosen over morning momentum (L=30m at 10:00 ET) because morning momentum concentrates in the low-vol SPY regime and lacks an ex-ante economic story; the reversal cluster is persistent across DoW and both vol regimes. Sector-relative primary representation (beta=1 to SPDR sector ETF) selected over raw for cleaner semantics; magnitude difference is small and both variants track together. Conditioning (low-volume amplifier from Phase 0C) intentionally left out of the frozen spec: it is a diagnostic, not part of this hypothesis. Falsification (skip=1 forward window) weakens but does not eliminate the bid-ask bounce alternative explanation; Phase 2 must monitor it.

phase2_embargo.reason: Phase 0 exploratory window is contamination for confirmation.

phase1_prerequisites: Independent long-history intraday dataset (target ~2018 -> present or longest practical).
PIT S&P 500 membership (historical additions/removals, ticker changes, delistings).
Explicit embargo of 2026-07-02 -> 2026-09-25 from Phase 2 partitions.
